text:
No option can be put forward from this run because neither stated success condition was scored.

- The £20k MRR threshold could not be aligned to the model’s outcome frame: no MRR baseline or target frame is recorded.
- The “monthly churn under 4%” limit is untested because churn is modelled as a calculated quantity, not measured on the same scale as that constraint.
- The comparison is most structurally sensitive to active Pro subscribers; its value is an Olumi inference, not user-supplied evidence. Feature-release value is also provisional and a tested change can alter the ordering, but investigation priority is not established.
